method: Same local Chrome WebGPU harness, sequential candidate and baseline; CPU shadow process + executor submit + flush timed, GPU completion outside timer; 3 warm-up and 15 measured frames, 64 draws/frame, each followed by a 4-byte update in a 256 KiB VBO. Controlled microbenchmark, not game trace acceptance.
notes: Counts cover all 18 frames. Baseline uploads a whole 256 KiB buffer 1152 times; candidate stages 4608 bytes. Logic copy fixtures restrict 16x16 destinations to 5x4 and 4x4 regions, including four-sample center coverage.
